tools.name: stratfile_init
tools.description: Translate a natural-language strategy idea into a deterministic, schema-validated stratfile.json

tools.name: stratfile_validate
tools.description: Validate a stratfile.json against schema v0.1.0 + hard invariants (no look-ahead, drawdown cap, testnet-only)

tools.name: stratfile_backtest
tools.description: Walk-forward backtest with regime stratification and Monte-Carlo drawdown bootstrap

tools.name: stratfile_receipt
tools.description: Emit a signed receipt.json: content hash + x402 payment proof + ECDSA signature

tools.name: stratfile_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt against its stratfile: hash recomputation, signature recovery, x402 proof check

tools.name: stratfile_execute
tools.description: Evaluate current regime and fire (or dry-run) one swap on PancakeSwap V3 BSC Testnet via the ERC-8004 agent
